sections.heading: Comprehensive Coverage
sections.text: With a comprehensive coverage, you get an extended coverage. It includes hospitalisation, medications, surgery, diagnostics and medical expenses for AYUSH hospitalisation. Hence, when you find yourself in unforeseen medical events, a comprehensive plan steps in to guard you.

sections.heading: Financial Safety
sections.text: Medical treatments are indeed expensive. As per reports, medical expenses have increased to 13% in India, higher than the global average of 10%. Thus, a comprehensive health insurance acts as a financial safety net and ensures that healthcare quality is not compromised due to financial constraints.

sections.heading: Tax Benefits
sections.text: If you are paying your premiums for comprehensive health insurance plans, then you are eligible for a tax deduction under Section 80D. According to the Income Tax Section 80D, a minimum of ₹50,000 deduction is available for senior citizens and a ₹25,000 tax deduction for non-senior citizens in each financial year.

sections.heading: Domiciliary Hospitalisation
sections.text: You get coverage benefits for selected medical expenses in at-home treatment on the advice of the doctor. Meaning, if you are diagnosed with a disease and, due to your health condition, the doctor has prescribed at-home treatment because you cannot be moved to the hospital. Your insurance company will give you coverage for this.

sections.heading: Riders or Add-on Benefits
sections.text: You can increase or enhance your comprehensive health insurance plan with additional coverage. Bajaj General Insurance offers the benefit of choosing additional coverage from health prime rider, respect rider (senior care), and non-medical expense rider.

sections.heading: What is the maximum sum insured available under this comprehensive policy?
sections.text: The maximum sum insured health insurance available under Bajaj General Insurance Comprehensive Health Insurance is ₹5 crore (you can choose cover starting from ₹3 lakh up to ₹5 crore, depending on the plan option you select).

sections.heading: Physiotherapy coverage health insurance
sections.text:
under Bajaj General Insurance's Comprehensive Health Plan depends on the nature of the treatment taken. If physiotherapy is part of a covered hospitalization/day-care treatment or falls within the plan’s specified pre-/post-hospitalization period and is medically prescribed, it may be payable as per policy terms and limits. Standalone OPD physiotherapy is covered only if your selected plan includes OPD benefits that allow it.
Are outpatient (OPD) expenses included in a comprehensive health insurance plan?
OPD cover health insurance is available under Bajaj General Insurance's Comprehensive Health Insurance in select plans. Where included, it can cover expenses such as tele-consultations, in-clinic doctor consultations, pathology/radiology tests, and an annual preventive health check-up—up to the limits specified in your chosen plan.

chunks.heading: What is the maximum sum insured available under this comprehensive policy?
chunks.text: The maximum sum insured health insurance available under Bajaj General Insurance Comprehensive Health Insurance is ₹5 crore (you can choose cover starting from ₹3 lakh up to ₹5 crore, depending on the plan option you select).

chunks.heading: Physiotherapy coverage health insurance
chunks.text:
under Bajaj General Insurance's Comprehensive Health Plan depends on the nature of the treatment taken. If physiotherapy is part of a covered hospitalization/day-care treatment or falls within the plan’s specified pre-/post-hospitalization period and is medically prescribed, it may be payable as per policy terms and limits. Standalone OPD physiotherapy is covered only if your selected plan includes OPD benefits that allow it.
Are outpatient (OPD) expenses included in a comprehensive health insurance plan?
OPD cover health insurance is available under Bajaj General Insurance's Comprehensive Health Insurance in select plans. Where included, it can cover expenses such as tele-consultations, in-clinic doctor consultations, pathology/radiology tests, and an annual preventive health check-up—up to the limits specified in your chosen plan.

chunks.heading: Is air ambulance service covered under comprehensive health insurance?
chunks.text: Air ambulance coverage health insurance is available under Bajaj General Insurance Comprehensive Health Insurance in select plans.
